command_line:
set -eu
export PATH="/software/atac-seq-pipeline:/software/atac-seq-pipeline/src:/home/g2main/.local/bin:/software/bedops_2.4.39/bin:/software/phantompeakqualtools-1.2.1:/software:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin:/software/kentUtils_bin_v377/bin"
export PYTHONPATH="/software/atac-seq-pipeline/src"
{
  printf 'caper_path='; command -v caper
  printf 'caper_version='; caper --version 2>&1
  printf 'wdl='; test -r /software/atac-seq-pipeline/atac.wdl && echo ok
  for x in bowtie2 samtools bedtools macs2 Rscript java bgzip tabix bedops shuf; do printf '%s=' "$x"; command -v "$x" || true; done
  printf '%s\n' 'software_top_level='; find /software -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d -printf '%f\n' | sort | head -80
} > runtime_probe.txt
